turns.text: Hey, how's it going? You doing okay?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My son wants an art class for his birthday and there are a few on offer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to describe all the options before I hear your opinion.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a weekend pottery and painting combo at the community center, for ages eight to twelve.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a comic drawing workshop run by a local illustrator, once a week after school.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Plus an online animation course where he'd learn to draw little cartoons on a tablet.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a summer art camp, five full days of everything from clay to collage.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So those are the options. What's your take?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What does he draw most on his own? If it's characters, I'd go comics, if it's anything and everything, the camp. The pottery combo is a nice taster if you're not sure yet.
